newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN LEU 3,176 TO DOLLAR FOR SEPTEMBER 9 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN LEU 3,176 TO DOLLAR FOR SEPTEMBER 9 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate at 3,176 to the dollar for September 9.
This reference rate was set on Thursday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Wednesday for September 6 to 8 is 3,177 to the dollar. It was 3,166 on Thursday.
